sentences.en: Overseas subsidiaries are putting out top-of the-line products.
sentences.zh: 海外子公司正在推出顶级产品。

sentences.en: It's a wholly-owned subsidiary, but it maintains some independence from its parent company.
sentences.zh: 这是一个全资子公司，但在运营上仍保持一定程度的独立性。

sentences.en: The company is our wholly-owned subsidiary.
sentences.zh: 该公司是我们全资拥有的子公司。

附属事物, 附属机构, 子公司
